style.vernacular: Anambra state capital in a cleared rainforest/wooded-savanna zone with heavy rain (about 2,170 mm). Ordinary buildings are 1-3 storey painted-render houses and lock-up shops in cream, light green and terracotta with rust-red or long-span coloured metal roofs; new business buildings, banks on Zik Avenue and over fifteen three-star hotels are changing the skyline; older infrastructure is described as decaying.
style.ornament: Igbo carved-wood doors and compound gates, mbari-style painted figures and uli wall designs on traditional sites (Imo-Oka shrine area, palaces); colonial watch towers in Awka town; modern churches with tall front towers and banks with coloured aluminium-composite fascias.

sources.what: tropical rainforest zone, 2,167 mm rain, forest cleared to wooded savannah; Zik Avenue banks; Eke Awka largest market; over 15 three-star hotels; Imo-Oka shrine remnants
